name: Handle With Care
summary: Curgle Cranklehop gives you a crate of eggs and asks you to carry it to the druid Erelas Ambersky, who can be found in Rut'theran, a small village in Teldrassil.

sections.title: A Crate of Eggs
sections.body: Curgle Cranklehop gives you a carefully packed crate of eggs. They are hippogryph eggs, and they are bound for a druid named Erelas Ambersky.

sections.title: The Druid of Rut'theran
sections.body: Erelas Ambersky is a druid who cares for these eggs. He helps them hatch and then trains the young hippogryphs. Rut'theran Village is a small village in Teldrassil, to the south.

faq.q: What is inside the crate from Curgle Cranklehop?
faq.answer: The carefully packed crate holds hippogryph eggs.

faq.q: Where does the crate need to go?
aliases: where do i take the crate
faq.answer: The crate goes to the druid Erelas Ambersky, in the small village of Rut'theran in Teldrassil.
Erelas Ambersky is a druid in Rut'theran Village. He looks after hippogryph eggs and trains the young hippogryphs once they hatch.
